content: Let's Encrypt hard rate limits: 300 new orders per account per 3 hours, 50 certificates per registered domain per week, plus duplicate-certificate limits. Caddy's on-demand TLS issues a cert at first TLS handshake for a new hostname (adds latency only on first connection). Critical risk: without an 'ask' endpoint gating which hostnames are allowed to trigger issuance, an attacker can point arbitrary DNS at your IP and trigger unlimited ACME orders, exhausting your account's rate limit and taking down cert issuance for legitimate customer domains. Must implement an on-demand 'ask' callback that checks the hostname against verified/pending domains in the DB before allowing Caddy to request a cert, plus max_certs cap.
